# Spectrum IT Solutions Ltd.
> Premier Dhaka-based software company providing digital identity, biometric infrastructure, smart card platforms, AI systems, and national-scale software engineering.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://spectrum.com.bd/index.html): Homepage with overview of capabilities
- [About](https://spectrum.com.bd/about-us.html): Company background, 12+ years experience, ISO 9001 & ISO 27001
- [Services](https://spectrum.com.bd/services.html): Digital identity, smart cards, AI, blockchain, cybersecurity, ERP
- [Digital Identity & Security](https://spectrum.com.bd/digital-identity-security.html): Guide to digital identity in Bangladesh (NID, e-KYC, verification, safety), plus automated ID verification
- [Smart Card Technologies](https://spectrum.com.bd/smart-card-technologies.html): Guide to smart cards (chips, security, issuance, smart cards in Bangladesh), plus Spectrum's card programmes such as the TCB family card
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://spectrum.com.bd/artificial-intelligence.html): Guide to AI (what it can do, Bangla, risks, starting a project), plus Spectrum's AI systems such as Upokari document verification
- [Blockchain Technology](https://spectrum.com.bd/blockchain-technology.html): Guide to blockchain (how it works, when you need one, Bangladesh), plus tamper-proof record systems
- [Products](https://spectrum.com.bd/products.html): Enterprise hardware and software products
- [Projects](https://spectrum.com.bd/projects.html): Delivered government and corporate projects
- [Case Studies](https://spectrum.com.bd/case-study.html): TCB Smart Family Card, Industrial e-Court BD, National e-Licensing, OCD certificate verification
- [Contact](https://spectrum.com.bd/contact.html): Enquiries and consultations
